title: feat(setup): the environment directory moves from Studio to Setup's access group
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-bill"} -->
_Requested by **Bill** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wg?thread=cmsg_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wgU5DKF7KXCzL3BS7FYTB4qi)_

Fixes #37565

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 岗位、能力、权限集、共享规则的全环境目录，从 Studio 菜单搬到 Setup 的“访问控制”分组，名为“岗位与权限”。
- Studio 菜单不再有这一项；对能进 Setup 的用户，旧的书签和链接只跳转一次，直接落到 Setup 的新页面；不能进 Setup 的 Studio 用户仍在 Studio 里看这些列表。
- 进入门槛没有放宽：新入口和新页面都要求进入 Studio 所需的同一项权限，外加 Setup 本身的权限。
- 在目录里点开某一条，仍在 Studio 的编辑器中打开；Studio 找不到包时的默认落点暂时改为“无包”范围，等“移入包”功能上线后一并撤掉。

## What changes

- **New Setup entry**: `nav_access_directory` ("Positions and Permissions", icon `key-round`) in Setup's `group_access_control`, contributed by `packages/platform-objects/src/apps/setup-nav.contributions.ts`, with `requiredPermissions: ['studio.access']`. Labels in all 11 locale packs, source hashes updated.
- **New Setup page** `security:access-directory` (`/apps/setup/component/security/access-directory`), registered in `builtinComponents.tsx`. It serves the directory and each environment type's list (`permission`, `position`, `capability`, `sharing_rule`, `?scope=environment`) by mounting the existing metadata-admin directory and list pages under the cross-package leg's host shape (no package, writable), rooted at the page. Without `studio.access` it renders an alert naming the capability and reads nothing.
- **Rows open the item editor in Studio**: an item, a create and a history under the Setup page go to `/studio/~all/metadata/<type>/<name>?scope=environment`, the editor the environment scope uses today, because an environment item is edited by name and may belong to no package.
- **Studio's `~all` menu entry is retired** (`studioMenuModel.ts`, its label key and icon). The package-less menu's access rows point at the Setup page's type lists for a user holding `setup.access`; without it they keep the Studio environment-scope lists (`/studio/~all/metadata/<type>?scope=environment`).
- **Old addresses redirect once**: `/studio/~all`, `/studio/~all/metadata` and a list of one of the four types in the environment scope, including Setup's old `/apps/setup/metadata/...` catalog addresses, land on the Setup page in one hop for a user holding `setup.access` (inside Studio read from the set Studio's entry gate hands its pages; on Setup's old aliases from the session's capability answer, read fail-closed). Without it, the leg keeps them and a bare `/studio/~all/…` lands on `/studio/~all/metadata`. The cross-package list of any other type, and item pages, stay in Studio.
- **Studio's no-package fallback** (`studioEntryFallbackPath`, `newPackageDoorPath`) now lands on `/studio/~org/metadata/flow?source=runtime` instead of the retired directory. ⚠️ This is temporary: `~org` retires with the Phase 4 "move into package" door (Q3 ruling 7184753035), and the fallback moves with it.
- The Studio package-not-found button's label (`engine.studio.notFound.allMetadata`, key unchanged) now names where it goes: "Open organization flows" / 打开「组织流程」.
- Surface added with the area's approval (claim amendments on #37565; the third adds the `setupMetadataStudioPath` call sites in `ui/packages/app-shell/src/console/AppContent.tsx` and `ui/apps/console/src/AppContent.tsx`): a one-line re-export of `ACCESS_DIRECTORY_PATH` (and, in the rework, `holdsSetupAccess`) from `ui/packages/app-shell/src/index.ts`; a doc-comment-only edit in `StudioEntryRedirect.tsx`; one sentence each in `content/docs/permissions/authorization.mdx` and `content/docs/permissions/permission-sets.mdx`, and two lines of `content/docs/permissions/administrator-guide.mdx` (the matrix editor's path and the where-to-find table row), re-pointed at Setup → Access Control (second claim amendment); and `StudioPaletteGroups.tsx` drops the retired kind's icon key and its import, which the full build refused to compile.

### Answer to #37424 comment 7188504633 (a)

The package's 全部类型 directory still lists `datasource` where the package holds one, and that tile still opens Setup → Datasources (the directory's href override). This PR does not change that; removing the menu row is #37564's job. The new Setup access directory lists only the four environment types and never `datasource`.

## Tests

- New: `views/setup/accessDirectory.test.ts` (address model: what lands on Setup, what stays in Studio, one hop both ways) and `views/setup/AccessDirectoryPage.test.tsx` (gate refusal with control, the host shape, the four lists, scope added, items/create/history open in Studio).
- Re-pointed, not weakened: every test that pinned `~all` now pins the Setup page or the Studio item editor, and the retired entry is pinned absent (`studioMenuModel`, `StudioMenu`, `StudioPaletteGroups.surfaceScope-36900`, `setupMetadataRedirect`, `AppContent.setupMetadataStudio-28578`, console `AppContent.legacyRedirects`, `AppContent.systemHubRoutes`, `StudioRoute.metadataArea-28561`, `StudioEntryRedirect`, `HomePage.noAgentsBuildChip-26614`, `StudioDesignSurface.metadataArea-28561`, `StudioMetadataArea.routes-28561`, `StudioPackageMenu-37139` (its `~all/overview` case now lands on Setup, plus an item page the leg still draws), `StudioDesignSurface.notFound-26708`, `SidebarAppMenu-36112`, `AppContent.emptyNavigationLanding-12079`, `AppContent.noAppComponentRoutes` (the zero-app legacy directory alias: one hop to Setup, then the no-apps empty state that branch renders for every Setup page; ablated: identity `studioAddressAfterSetupMove` turns it red), `AppContent.pseudoRouteSegments`), and the live e2e `declared-sharing-rules-reach-13091` lists from the Setup page.

## Acceptance notes

- The access rule does not widen: the Setup entry and the page both require `studio.access` on top of Setup's own access, with parity with the Studio gate pinned by test.
- Sequencing: `studioMenuModel.ts` and `StudioMenu.tsx` are also edited by #37454 (PR #37546); main is merged once after it lands. Whichever of this PR and #37564 lands second merges main.

## Verification

Rework round (seat L1 at `4320d105`), pushed on the same branch, no rebase. Head `0471b08e`; CI result is reported on the PR once green.

- M1: parity with the Studio gate, pinned on each of that gate's own policy cases (holder, operator, tenant owner, reported empty set, no reported set), with an ablation that turns the parity tests red.
- S1: full-chain `toEqual([from, to])` restored in both `AppContent.systemHubRoutes` tables and the `TO_SETUP_DIRECTORY` block of `AppContent.setupMetadataStudio-28578`.
- S2: both branches tested in `studioMenuModel`, `StudioMenu`, `StudioMetadataArea.routes-28561` and console `StudioRoute.metadataArea-28561`; ablating the four `setup.access` reads turns 12 cases red.
- S3 (delta review): Setup's old catalog aliases (`/apps/*/metadata…`, `component/metadata/directory`, `system/{positions,roles,permissions}`) take the same `setup.access` branch, a set never reported counting as none. Both branches and the no-answer case are pinned in `setupMetadataRedirect`, `AppContent.setupMetadataStudio-28578`, console `AppContent.systemHubRoutes` and `AppContent.legacyRedirects`; ablating the branch (42 cases) or reading it fail-open turns them red.
- N1/N2: the i18n comment and the two doc sentences corrected (only the `?scope=environment` lists redirect, and only for a user who can open Setup).
- Unit: all 20 test files this branch touches green. Type-check: `@object-ui/app-shell`, `@object-ui/console` green. Gates: `check:test-source-alias`, `check:i18n`, `check:nul-bytes`, `check:doc-authoring`, `check-affected-docs` green.

Earlier round, at `4320d105`: CI 61 success, 0 failed; derived gates (67 commands) green, full `pnpm build` and `pnpm console:build` green.

- Browser, showcase app booted locally, signed in as the seeded admin, light and dark (8 screenshots):
  - `/apps/setup/component/security/access-directory` shows the directory of the four types, with **Access Control → Positions and Permissions** selected in Setup's sidebar.
  - `/studio/com.example.showcase/metadata`: the Studio menu's Access group no longer carries the cross-package entry.
  - An old link, `/studio/~all/metadata/position?scope=environment`, lands on `/apps/com.objectstack.setup/component/security/access-directory/position?scope=environment` and lists the 17 positions.
- Follow-up noted, not in this card: the Setup page reuses the directory's own heading ("All Metadata Types"); a page-specific heading would read better.
